text:
Predicates:
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is published by y.
Translate(x, y) ::: x is translated from language y.
PublishedInEnglish(x) ::: x is published in English.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Premises:
Specialize(NewVesselPress, translatingForeignLiterature) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English.
∀x (PublishedBy(NewVesselPress, x) → PublishedInEnglish(x)) ::: All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
Book(neapolitanChronicles) ∧ PublishedBy(neapolitanChronicles, NewVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Translate(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
Book(palaceOfFlies) ∧ PublishedBy(palaceOfFlies, NewVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
¬PublishedBy(harryPotter, NewVesselPress) ::: Harry Potter was published by New Vessel Press.
